verdicts.evidence: Diff 07fa463..01baa4d touches none of the finding's three named sites (DocLints.jl:17, TestHarness.jl:591, CLI/Doctor.jl:5-9) — their gloss already existed at baseline. This diff adds the same gloss to docs/src/index.md:57 and the four instruments/*/PROTOCOL.md:4 preambles, on the theory that the PROTOCOL preamble is the phrase's real first use for every instrument session. That's false: templates/SKILL.md.tmpl:7 ('runs the quick doctor and `gbg self verify`') is bare prose a session reads BEFORE the `!`gbg preflight`` call that prints the now-glossed PROTOCOL.md text, and it renders into 10 untouched SKILL.md copies plus docs/src/guide/rounds.md:13, Preflight.jl:617/628 and ARCHITECTURE.md all still bare. Named instances fine; the class survives at the true entry point.
